description: This is a partial specification of an object to be used when documenting the data sources for an evaluated value.  The remaining portions of the data will be specified in-place in different schemata in order to ensure consistency in the data.

nsrKeys.description: The NSR keys associated with a measurement.

isIncluded.description: Indicates whether this value is included in, for example, a weighted average.

comment.description: This should be at most a short note, not a detailed discussion.  It will appear inline in the documentation for the quantity being evaluated.
